segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the product as light, balancing, and not greasy, with one calling it perfect for oily skin and another noting reduced overnight oiliness alongside acne control.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the product helps with dryness and dry patches, though a few say it is too light or not moisturizing enough in cold winter weather.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say the product balances their skin without residue or excess shine.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report good tolerance, hydration, and no breakouts or allergic reactions, but one reviewer without sensitive skin reports burning and irritation and another notes eye-burning on contact.
segments.mature: One reviewer notes the product is suited for aging skin as well as younger skin, and another mentions using it hoping to see improvement in facial wrinkles.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the product for fine lines and wrinkles around the eyes report reduced puffiness and fine lines, and one hopes to see further improvement over time; effects are described as gradual rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, quick hydration and a dewy, refreshed feel; a minority say it is not moisturizing enough for very dry or cold-weather skin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product fading redness including a scar over three weeks, while another reports the mist itself caused new redness after application.
concerns.barrier: A reviewer with seasonal eczema found the moisturizer appropriate and soothing for a sensitive, compromised barrier, with no negative barrier reports found elsewhere.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers dealing with acne report fewer breakouts and better overnight control, with some residual blemishes still present; no reports of worsened acne.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the product controls oiliness and dries out acne overnight without feeling heavy, with no reports of increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Formula reportedly thinned or watery now

extraits.texte: I got this due to sensitive skin that also breaks out easily with products. It has been good to my sensitive skin and has helped with acne BUT its too light for dry skin so it hasnt helped moisturize.

First I think its important to disclose your age and skin type as your skin changes at different stages in life. I'm 39, and have dry skin. I picked this up along with several other dermalogica products and have been using them for 4 months. I wanted to use it for a while before reviewing. This is probably my favorite dermalogica product. It works well for my skin type. It's a light, fragrance free moisturizer. Doesn't irritate my skin. I use it daily. The downside is obviously the cost. I do get dry patches on my skin from time to time that I have to use a heavier moisturizer on, but daily use this is a great product.

extraits.titre: Been using Active Moist for decades!
extraits.texte: This is a tried & true product, I know because I've been using it for literally decades. It has no added perfumes, not greasy & my sensitive skin always feels moisturized & no breakouts either. I wear it under makeup every day & to bed every night.

I'm cheap and don't like spending too much money on anything if I can avoid it. But I have the most ridiculous acne I've ever met. I'm in my early 30s and until I started using this I couldn't get it under control. I still have a few blemishes here and there but nothing like what I had before. I no longer wake up feeling super oily, and it dries my acne out overnight. The price is worth it!

This is the best eye cream I've used in years. I can see improvement already and I've only been using it for 3 weeks. The only thing I don't like is that it burns my eyes. I have to be extremely careful not to get it close to my eyes otherwise it seeps in burns. Then I have to rinse the whole eye and start over. Which is counterproductive seeing as though it's made for the eyes.

I purchased this moisturizer for my daughter at the recommendation of our esthetician. Her skin is sensitive and she experiences seasonal eczema which requires a moisturizer which is appropriate to those needs.
Absolutely love this moisturizer. It isn't too much on my combination skin. It's very hydrating and makes my skin extra smooth.
